headline: 3 Warrant Manipulation Perpetrators Detained by OJK, IDX Speaks Up
summary: Indonesia's financial regulator OJK has detained three people suspected of manipulating warrant trading. The Indonesia Stock Exchange commented on the investigation.
why: Warrants are derivative securities listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, and manipulation cases affect market integrity and investor trust.
original_headline: 3 Pelaku Manipulasi Waran Ditahan OJK, BEI Buka Suara
